noun_definition: Edit box refers to the user interface element that allows users to modify an existing comment in the application.
compose box refers to the user interface element that allows users to create new comments, which should visually align with the edit box when editing existing comments.
Bit refers to a small amount of movement or displacement that occurs when the edit box slides over during the editing of an existing comment.
Comment refers to a user-generated text entry that can be edited within a report in the application.
